'''Processing Vane 5''' was one of many vanes across [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] to filter [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and freeze it in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] blocks. It was overseen by [[Negri]], a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]].
